docSummary: Agency X is scoping an AMS engagement covering 12 eServices (SRs, incidents by severity, CRs, batch job failures), with L1 run by the agency's own help desk and an incumbent services team of 30-36 FTE. The FY25 summary table covers 12 months (April 2025-31 March 2026), so monthly figures were derived by dividing totals by 12: SRs 3066/12≈255.5, CRs 202/12≈16.83, and incidents (SevA 155 + SevB 474 + SevC 7 + Job Failures 92 = 728)/12≈60.67/month. Severities were mapped SevA→P1 (21.29%), SevB→P2 (65.11%), SevC→P3 (0.96%), and Job Failures→P4 (12.64%) as an assumption since job failures are not explicitly severity-tagged. Two separate manual automation efforts (account review and log analysis) were discussed as opportunities, not as part of the AMS tower. The platform/infrastructure team (18 FTE) and cloud hosting are run by a separate vendor/tender and are excluded from scope.

warnings: Incident/SR/CR totals in the FY25 table span 12 months (Apr2025-Mar2026); monthly figures were computed by dividing by 12 - verify this conversion against the source.
Incident mix assumes Job Failures count as P4 incidents (job failures are not severity-tagged in the source) - verify this mapping.

Session 3 states 'platform-wide Sev A was reported as 6 for FY25 in the earlier session', but the Session 4 table totals Sev A at 155 (sum of per-eService figures) - used the table value as more recent/detailed, flag conflict.

The bid team's own AI-generated analysis (page 5) flags five numbers as suspicious (Callup Sev A=140, Leave and Claims 1600 SRs vs only 10 CRs, Retail 890 SRs with 1 CR and 54 job failures) - these came from the client table but the ratios look anomalous and should be checked with the client.
eng.incumbentFTE uses the midpoint (33) of the stated range '30 to 36 people'.

eng.pass23 (5%) is derived from 'less than 5% are handled at L3', an upper-bound estimate, not an exact figure; pass12 was omitted because L1 is explicitly out of scope for the vendor (handled by the agency's own help desk).
An L1.5 team of 3-4 people (24x7, manual, run by the agency) sits between L1 and L2 but is not assigned to a tier per instructions - review whether this team's effort should be reflected elsewhere.

L3 ownership is not stated in the document and was omitted; the platform/infrastructure team (18 FTE) and cloud hosting are run by a separate vendor/tender and were excluded as out of scope (not sized as a tower).
Two conflicting user-count figures appear: 'Fewer than 1000 users are supported' vs '4000 concurrent users at maximum' (governance) - unclear which represents MAU; mau field was omitted.
crMix (change request complexity) was not quantified in the document beyond qualitative notes ('mostly policy driven', 'time consuming') and was omitted.

No delivery-location/region information was found for the bidder's team; Singapore is only mentioned as the cloud hosting region (run by a separate hosting vendor), not the delivery location - eng.region/locMix were omitted.
Engagement term (contract length) is not stated in the document and was omitted.

Account review and log analysis are separate manual-automation efforts (listed under opportunities), not part of the AMS tower sizing; account-review scope changed mid-document from 10 systems to '12 sources across 5 categories'.
SLA response/resolution targets were not quantified beyond 'SRs are under SLAs' - sla object was omitted.
